routingNotes.C-D: CHUM January 2026 guide states public circulation between Pavilions C and D is available at the 1st, 2nd and 8th floors.
routingNotes.D-R: CHUM January 2026 guide states the underground passage at basement level 1 between Pavilions D and R is accessible to all and provides access to Champ-de-Mars métro.
routingNotes.C-F: Not included in public graph: the 5th-floor walkway is staff-only and the basement-2 passage is staff/physician/logistics only.
routingNotes.E-F: Not included in public graph: the underground passage is staff/physician and escorted-patient only.

en: Use a public connector from Pavilion C to Pavilion D on floor 1, 2 or 8.
fr: Empruntez une liaison publique du pavillon C vers le pavillon D au 1er, 2e ou 8e étage.

en: Use a public connector from Pavilion D to Pavilion C on floor 1, 2 or 8.
fr: Empruntez une liaison publique du pavillon D vers le pavillon C au 1er, 2e ou 8e étage.

en: Go to basement level 1 in Pavilion D and use the public underground passage to Pavilion R.
fr: Rendez-vous au sous-sol 1 du pavillon D et empruntez le passage souterrain public vers le pavillon R.

en: Go to basement level 1 in Pavilion R and use the public underground passage to Pavilion D.
fr: Rendez-vous au sous-sol 1 du pavillon R et empruntez le passage souterrain public vers le pavillon D.
